metadata.dataset: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (PIP) — Percentiles
metadata.source: World Bank PIP via Our World in Data catalog mirror
metadata.referenceYear: latest survey year per economy (see distributions[].year), constant 2021 int-$
metadata.pppBasis: 2021 PPP international dollars; conversion PA.NUS.PRVT.PP (LCU per int-$, private consumption)
metadata.incomeDefinition: household disposable income or consumption, per capita
metadata.methodology: country: 99-threshold percentile lookup, log-linear interpolation, capped at Top 1%; world: pooled population-weighted country bins ordered by welfare (not an average of country percentiles)
limitations: Survey welfare is household income/consumption per capita; user input is personal gross income.
Survey years differ by economy; pooled world mixes latest years in constant 2021 int-$.
Household surveys under-cover the extreme top tail; results cap at Top 1%.
Non-local currency entry uses the issuing economy's PPP factor (disclosed in UI).
